en_before: Cybergoth is not identical to Cyber Y2K. Cyber Y2K reinterprets early-2000s futurism through metallics, low-rise shapes, technical graphics and clubwear. Cybergoth more strongly emphasizes industrial or rave references, black-neon contrast and specific accessories. For its history, hair, makeup and clothing, read the dedicated cybergoth guide; this article remains a comparison.
